title: Find the Minimum Possible Sum of a Beautiful Array
summary: Given positive integers n and target, find the smallest possible sum of a unique array of n elements where no two distinct elements sum to the target, and return this sum modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Given positive integers n and target, find the smallest possible sum of a unique array of n elements where no two distinct elements sum to the target, and return this sum modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Choose n distinct positive integers with no two summing to target.
Return the minimum possible sum modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Among values below target, use only the smaller side of each forbidden complementary pair.
Take 1 through target//2, then continue from target upward if more values are needed.
Use arithmetic-series formulas for the two ranges and reduce modulo M.
Every skipped low complement conflicts with an already smaller chosen value, while target and above cannot form target with a positive number.
